users.title: Users
users.description: User profiles authenticated via Google or anonymous sessions

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Shared business venture or partnership ledger with multi-tenancy access control

entries.title: Ledger Entries
entries.description: Financial capital contributions, expenses, loans, reimbursements, and decisions belonging to a project

auditLogs.title: Audit Logs
auditLogs.description: Immutable audit trail of actions taken on projects and entries

/users/{userId}.description: Individual user document accessible only by the user

/projects/{projectId}.description: Project document with tenant security check (ownerUid, authorizedUserUids, authorizedEmails, or demo mode)

/projects/{projectId}/entries/{entryId}.description: Project ledger entries strictly inheriting parent project multi-tenant membership

/projects/{projectId}/auditLogs/{logId}.description: Project audit logs strictly inheriting parent project multi-tenant membership

/entries/{entryId}.description: Top-level ledger entries verified against parent project access

/auditLogs/{logId}.description: Top-level audit logs verified against parent project access
